system.description:
You learn one or more Force Powers.

Prerequisites: Force Sensitivity, Trained in Use the Force.

Effect: You add to your Force Power Suite a number of Force Powers equal to 1 + your Intelligence modifier (Minimum 1). You can add the same Force Power more than once.

Special: You can take this Feat more than once. Each time you take this Feat, you add to your Force Power Suite a number of new Force Powers equal to 1 + your Intelligence modifier.

Additional Force Training Effects

Combined Feat (Improved Disarm): When you use the Force Disarm Force Power, you gain the +5 bonus from Improved Disarm on your Use the Force check as though you were making an attack roll.
